title: IoT Device Security Stack
description: A Mermaid flowchart of a representative IoT device drawn from the immutable silicon root of trust up through boot loader, firmware, OS, and application code, with a mutual-TLS channel to the cloud management plane.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

learningObjectives: Identify the layers of an IoT device security stack from the hardware root of trust to the cloud management plane.
Explain why trust diminishes and blast radius grows as you move up the stack.
prerequisites: Basic idea of firmware, operating systems, and TLS

instructionalStrategies: Read the stack bottom-up, hovering each layer to see its security role.
Discuss why the OTA / firmware layer is the most common attack surface.

assessmentQuestions.question: Why can the silicon root of trust not be re-flashed, and why does that matter?
A backend compromise and a single-device firmware compromise differ in blast radius. Explain the difference.
